Get Althea's ashes and bring them back to Duke Barradin.

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Find the temple where [[Lady Althea|Althea]] was killed and use the '''[[Barradin Family Urn]]''' to gather her ashes.
*Bring [[Urn of Althea's Ashes|Althea's Ashes]] to [[Duke Barradin]].

===Reward===
*2,000 [[Experience]]
* 300 {{gold}} ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
First, make sure you have the [[Barradin Family Urn]]. 

Head to [[Diessa Lowlands]] in order to reach the [[Flame Temple Corridor]] where the ashes are located. It is easier to start from the [[Grendich Courthouse]], but if player hasn't been there yet, it's possible to start from Piken Square and get to Diessa Lowlands from [[The Breach]]. The entrance to the Flame Temple Corridor is in the north-east corner of the Diessa Lowlands across the large [[tar]] pit.

Once at the Flame Temple Corridor, fight several groups of [[Charr]] and get to the altar where Althea's ashes are. There will be four [[Ascalon Striker]]s allies, but they aren't very strong. It's advisable to clear a single path towards the altar. The altar is guarded by a large group of Charr, so players should try to avoid aggroing too many groups at once. After the Charr have been cleared, interact with the Altar and the [[Barradin Family Urn]] will turn into the [[Urn of Althea's Ashes]].

An alternative to killing the large groups of Charr at the altar would be to just run up and click on the altar, instead of fighting the Charr. Consider using henchmen as a decoy.

==Dialogue== 
===Initial dialogue=== 
;Duke Barradin
:''"I have been thinking about this story you told me of my daughter's ghost. I fear she cannot rest until her ashes are recovered and properly interred. Please go to the '''Flame Temple Corridor''' and gather '''Althea's ashes'''. Bring them back to me so I can lay her to rest. You'll have my gratitude."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = I know that what I ask of you may not even be possible, but I'd be grateful if you'd try. Bring me '''Althea's ashes''' so she can rest in peace.
}}
:If your character does not have an urn in their inventory:
::{{Ask}} '''Ask:''' ''"What's this? You've lost the urn that was to hold my daughter's ashes? Please...I have placed my trust in you. Be more careful in the future."'' (The following appears in your chat window: "Duke Barradin hands you a Barradin Family Urn.")
:If your character does not have an urn in their inventory and their inventory is full:
::{{Ask}} '''Ask:''' ''"Your inventory is full. Please make room and speak to me again."'' (The following appears in your chat window: "Duke Barradin tries to hand you a Barradin Family Urn, but your inventory is full.")

===Reward dialogue===
;Duke Barradin
:''"Althea's ashes... You have put this father's heart at ease. I thank you." ''

==Notes==
*Having [[The Titan Source]] active will make this quest much more difficult.
*To collect the ashes one must have the Barradin Family Urn in your inventory.
*If player does not have the urn in their inventory, talking to Duke Barradin will give another.
*It is possible to get multiple urns by placing them into the Storage and talking to Duke Barradin.
*Having multiple urns into the inventory, it is possible to interact with the altar multiple times to get multiple ashes from one single visit.
*It is possible to complete the quest by buying the ashes from another player.
*It is not possible to collect ashes from the altar if the quest is not active or is completed.

==Trivia==
*In ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'', an ascended accessory equipment item is named [[gw2:Althea's Ashes|Althea's Ashes]], with the flavor text: ''"The legendary beauty who captured the heart of Prince Rurik, only to perish in the Searing of Ascalon."''
*This quest was only available for Prophecies characters until the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260428|April 28th, 2026]] update.
